name: manual_8896b8
claim: In zsh, bracketed local requirement paths such as `./dir[extra]` must be quoted when passed as a shell argument; otherwise filename generation can rewrite or reject the path before the installer receives it. Use a quoted argument and verify that the intended local checkout was installed.

decisions.notes: Supersedes the command example that left a bracketed local path exposed to zsh filename generation; require literal argument passing and installation verification.

rationale: Supersedes the command example that left a bracketed local path exposed to zsh filename generation; require literal argument passing and installation verification.
